title: MOODWAAVE: Lightweight, High-Efficiency Music Genre and Emotion Analysis on Edge CPU Hardware
description: MOODWAAVE is an ultra-lightweight, CPU-optimized music information retrieval (MIR) architecture and comprehensive reproduction suite. It delivers joint 10-class music genre classification (GTZAN) and continuous Valence/Arousal emotion regression (PMEmo) with distribution-free conformal prediction bounds, running orders of magnitude faster than real-time playback on standard consumer CPUs without requiring GPU acceleration. This release includes complete experimental pipelines, artist-disjoint validation splits, statistical equivalence audits (TOST), cross-dataset evaluations (FMA, DEAM), foundation model comparisons (VGGish, PANNs, MERT), and a turnkey cross-platform benchmarking kit.
